title: Löhrstraße, Vallendar
description:
Coliving in Vallendar

📍 Prime Location in Vallendar:
* Located in the heart of Vallendar, close to the Rhine
* Walking distance to WHU – Otto Beisheim School of Management and local shops
* Excellent public transport connections to Koblenz and the surrounding area
* Surrounded by cafés, restaurants and everyday amenities  

🏡 Living Options:
* Fully furnished private rooms in shared apartments
* Shared bathrooms and fully equipped shared kitchens
* Comfortable shared living areas

🎯 Amenities & Benefits:
* Fully furnished rooms ready to move in
* Weekly cleaning service for shared areas
* Free WiFi and access to washing machines
* Fully equipped bedding included (140 × 200 cm beds)
* Digital onboarding and move-in process

📜 Rental Terms:
* Minimum rental period: 3 months
* 3-month notice period to the end of a calendar month

📢 For the Booking:
* 2 months’ rent deposit
* Booking fee (€195)
* Signed contract
* Copy of your ID

The charm and character of European buildings make variations within each category inevitable, even though the suites are similar in size and furnishing. All size specifications are approximate and may vary slightly. The images show a sample suite within the chosen category and may differ from the suite you are allocated.
